faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to commit disorderly conduct. A person commits
               disorderly conduct if he intentionally, knowingly, or recklessly:
(1)
Makes a coarse and obviously offensive utterance, gesture, or display in a public
                  place and the utterance, gesture, or display tends to incite an immediate breach of
                  the peace; or
(2)
Fights with another in a public place, except in an amateur or professional contest
                  of athletic skill.
(Code 1960, § 17-6; Code 1981, § 21-20; Ord. No. 3377, § 2, 7-7-1997)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 18-9-106.
